name: omnisense/omnisign
description: Omnisign: one contract for having documents signed - create an envelope (documents, signers, fields, a level: simple, advanced, qualified), send it, follow it, remind, cancel, sign in the application's page, download the signed documents and their evidence, hear the provider's webhooks - whoever signs: Yousign (omnisign/yousign), DocuSign (omnisign/docusign), a DocuSeal instance (omnisign/docuseal); and its Symfony bundle.

suggest.omnisign/yousign: Yousign (Youtrust): simple, advanced and qualified signatures, by e-mail or in the page
suggest.omnisign/docusign: DocuSign eSignature: envelopes, embedded signing, Connect webhooks
suggest.omnisign/docuseal: DocuSeal: an instance of one's own (open source) or DocuSeal's cloud - nothing leaves for a third party when self-hosted
suggest.symfony/config: In a Symfony application: the configuration of Omnisign\Bridge\Symfony\OmnisignBundle
suggest.symfony/dependency-injection: In a Symfony application: the services of Omnisign\Bridge\Symfony\OmnisignBundle
suggest.symfony/http-kernel: In a Symfony application: Omnisign\Bridge\Symfony\OmnisignBundle itself
